guarantees.claim: While rst_ni is low, ctrl_err_storage_q is asynchronously forced to 0.
When rst_ni is high and ctrl_err_storage_d is asserted, ctrl_err_storage_q is set to 1 at the next rising clock edge.
When rst_ni is high and ctrl_err_storage_d is deasserted, ctrl_err_storage_q retains its previous value.

assumptions.claim: ctrl_err_storage_d correctly indicates a genuine control error and is deasserted when no error present.
assumptions.risk: Spurious assertion of ctrl_err_storage_d will permanently set the error flag until reset, causing false fault handling.

uncertain_points.claim: The error storage register is sticky (set only by ctrl_err_storage_d, cleared only by reset). It has no software-clear or acknowledge path.
uncertain_points.risk: If the system requires error recovery without a full reset, the design may be missing a clear mechanism, leading to persistent error state and potential denial of service.
